sharpen a term when a conversation resolves its meaning. Architectural decisions live in `docs/adr/`.
The privacy-preserving AI subsystem (`src/AndrewCrm.Web/Services/Ai/` plus the per-treatment services)
adds source-backed assistance to the contact communication workflow without sending raw PII to the model.
- **Treatment** ΓÇö one of the three AI features: **Catch Me Up** (relationship briefing), **Message
Intelligence** (advisory message analysis), **Suggested Next Action** (composer nudge). Persisted on
- **Invocation** ΓÇö one run of a treatment against a contact: retrieve ΓåÆ tokenise ΓåÆ reserve budget ΓåÆ call
the model ΓåÆ validate ΓåÆ persist. Usage and audit are recorded per invocation.
- **AI Invocation module** (`AiInvocation`) ΓÇö the single application-owned orchestration boundary the spec
requires. It owns the invariant, fail-closed pipeline (tenant restore, budget reservation, retry, provider
call, audit, failureΓåÆsafe-code mapping) shared by every treatment. No treatment reimplements it.
- **Treatment descriptor** (`IAiTreatment`) ΓÇö a treatment expressed as data (system prompt, response schema,
token cap, prompt version) plus small policy hooks (retrieval/`PrepareAsync`, per-attempt and post-provider
- **Retrieval context** (`AiRetrievalContext`, of `AiRetrievalSource`) ΓÇö the eligible, retrieval-profiled
current-contact sources a treatment gathers, plus the snapshot identity used for deduplication and freshness.
Feature-neutral: every treatment builds one before the PII gateway. (Formerly `CatchMeUpContext`.)
- **PII gateway** (`PiiGateway`) ΓÇö replaces permitted identifiers and sensitive values with random,
request-scoped placeholders, producing a **tokenised context** (`TokenisedContext`) that is all the model
ever sees. Reversible mappings live only in invocation memory and are never persisted.
- **Artifact** (`AiArtifact`) ΓÇö the tenant-owned, contact-scoped, retained result of an invocation: treatment,
lifecycle status, tokenised structured content, protected display projection, source links, freshness
anchor, usage linkage, and safe failure code.
- **Source authorization** (`AiSourceAuthorizationService`) ΓÇö the central access boundary re-checked before
retrieval, processing, reuse, and display; a claim derived from a source the current user cannot access is
